answer: Slashable stake bonds paired with per-epoch execution checks force an attacker to lock real capital for every new key. To forge fifty sybil nodes, an operator must deposit 200 tokens per wallet into a 30-day escrow contract and pay compute costs on unique seed tasks, like a LiDAR elevation check on a rocky knoll or a willow blight scan. If a spot audit detects shared nonces or replayed outputs between two accounts, the contract burns the full deposit of both keys.
